cr-wabeno-bank-loot-1921.st: The chase ran south of Wabeno: on 16 July posses closed on Mountain (Oconto County), and on 19-20 July some 300 men besieged the gang in the Carter woods (Carter, about 3.5 miles SSE of Wabeno), where two deputies were shot before the gang broke out over the cutover.
cr-wabeno-bank-loot-1921.t: The "buried in the woods some distance from Wabeno" claim fits the 16-20 July flight corridor Wabeno-Carter-Mountain as well as the later search ground 7 miles north. 1938 air photos of the Carter cutover and the 1912 Forest County plat would show the logging trails.
src: Marshfield News-Herald, 16 Jul 1921, p. 1 (Newspapers.com 451037852): first AP report, $5,000 cash and $22,000 Liberty bonds; cashier and assistant cashier locked in the vault; posses around Mountain
"Wabeno Bank Bandits Wound Two Deputies," Wisconsin Rapids Daily Tribune, 20 Jul 1921, p. 3 (Newspapers.com 242701929): 300-man posse, siege of Carter woods
